title: Explorer cucumber: Yield, Maturity and Characteristics
metaTitle: Explorer cucumber: Yield, Maturity and Characteristics
metaDescription: Explorer cucumber is a cucumber variety. About 34 days to harvest, 33.6 t/ha in trials. See its pest ratings and traits.
excerpt: Explorer is a registered cucumber variety. The Philippine Seed Board approved it in 1980. JMC Farms bred it. It takes about 34 days from sowing to the first harvest, with 33.62 tonnes per hectare on average in the trials.

**Yield:** 33.62 tonnes per hectare on average in the trials.
**Recommended for:** the areas in its trials, in both the wet and the dry season.

blocks.text: How long does it take, and how much does it yield?

Explorer cucumber takes about 34 days from sowing to the first harvest. That is 5.2 days faster than the average of the 5 cucumber varieties with a day count, 39.2 days. A shorter crop frees the field sooner and dodges more of the weather, while a longer one often fills more.

Its average yield of 33.62 t/ha beats the average of its group, 25. It sits in the top quarter of its group. Trial yields come from well managed plots, so your own will depend on water, fertilizer, pests and timing.

Once you know the day count, anee.io dates every task from each lot's own planting day, with [the growth stages and weather](/features/growth-stages-and-weather) beside it.
Is it resistant to pests and diseases?

blocks.caption: Reactions in the registry trials, rated under natural field conditions

blocks.text: It showed no weak spot in the ratings on record. Still, a resistant variety can break down when a new strain or pest population comes, so keep scouting. Read up on [anthracnose](/diseases/anthracnose).

The pests and diseases that hit cucumber fields most often: [damping off](/diseases/damping-off), [downy mildew of cucurbits](/diseases/downy-mildew), [leafminer](/pests/leafminer), [melon fly](/pests/melon-fly), [powdery mildew](/diseases/powdery-mildew). Our [pest finder](/pests) and [disease finder](/diseases) help you name what you see.
Where and when to plant Explorer cucumber

It is recommended for both the wet and the dry season. Cucumber gives its first fruit fast, often in five to six weeks. Pick a variety bred to tolerate downy mildew if you plant near the rains. Before planting, get the field ready with our guide: [Pagtatanim ng gulay](/crops/pagtatanim-ng-gulay).

items.q: How long does it take to harvest?
items.a: It takes about 34 days from sowing to the first harvest. Then the weather and your care decide the exact day.
The record shows 33.62 tonnes per hectare on average in the trials. Your own yield depends on the soil, water, fertilizer and pests on your farm.

items.q: Where can I buy seed of Explorer?
items.a: Ask an accredited seed dealer in your province, the seller named on this page or your municipal agriculturist. Look for the certified seed tag or a sealed pack before you pay.
